newsitem.title: UK: BT hits record peak on U.S. buying.
newsitem.headline: BT hits record peak on U.S. buying.

text.p: Shares in British Telecommunications Plc rose to an all-time high on Tuesday amid strong buying from U.S. investors, traders said.
By 1105 GMT BT was up 8-1/2p to 479 after touching a record intraday trading high of 483p earlier in the session.
"Investors from the U.S. are in and as there is a shortage in BT, the stock is poised to go up further ", one trader said. "A lot of people believe it will go over five pounds", he added.

BT which recently won approval from the European Commission for its ambitious $20-billion merger with U.S. telecoms group MCI Communications Corp, hopes to receive clearance from the U.S. authorities before the end of the year.
